value.rationale: The parity of every alphabet size is a necessary-and-sufficient extinction criterion for the natural edge-neighbor linear automaton on arbitrary Hamming products. The exact nilpotent Jordan spectrum and first-hitting-time census depend nontrivially on \(H=\prod_i(m_i-2)\), a factor invisible in the already-known binary-cube case. This is a motivated infinite-family structural classification, not a routine finite table or arbitrary parameter slice.
